mining.title: Mining machinery and mineral processing equipment
mining.text: Design and manufacture of equipment for conveying, crushing, sizing and separating minerals, focused on hard and heavy materials such as ferrochrome, ferromanganese, ferroalloy products and industrial slag.

items.crushing: Crushing equipment: double-toggle jaw crushers and crushing equipment for hard and heavy materials.
items.screening: Sizing equipment: industrial screens and equipment for separating materials by size.
items.gravity: Gravity separation equipment: jig machines and shaking tables.
items.conveying: Material transfer equipment: feeding and conveying equipment between processing stages.
items.lines: Complete crushing and processing line equipment.

industrial.title: Industrial machinery, equipment and parts
industrial.text: Manufacture of machinery, equipment and parts for factory production lines, not limited to one industry, including steel, cement and ferroalloy plants.

items.molten: Molten metal handling: ladles for carrying molten metal and related equipment.
items.handling: Material handling: industrial hooks, material transfer equipment for smelting lines and handling of finished products.
items.dust: Industrial dust collection: dust-collection cyclones and related parts.
items.parts: Production line parts and equipment: custom parts, mechanical assemblies and special equipment.

engineering.title: Engineering, design and machinery rebuilding services
engineering.text: Turning customer needs into engineering designs, building special-purpose machines, reverse engineering and rebuilding existing equipment.

items.custom: Special-purpose machines: requirements intake, 3D modeling, drawings, manufacturing, assembly and testing.
items.reverse: Reverse engineering and improvement: examining an existing sample, performance analysis, defect identification, design correction and manufacturing.
items.rebuild: Heavy and mining machinery rebuilding: loader and excavator structures, hydraulic jacks, bucket rebuilding and reinforcement.
items.parts: Industrial parts: overhaul of mechanical assemblies, replacement parts and equipment improvement.

agri.title: Export agricultural machinery
agri.text: Land-leveling machinery with laser and satellite control systems, offered for export.
